card.what: Small moulded composite V-cleat with a fairlead eye, for 3-6 mm control lines (cunningham, outhaul, vang tail, jib cars, centreboard and kicker lines on dinghies)
card.boats: Not placed yet. Candidates: the Sunfish's outhaul and cunningham tails (layouts/sunfish.json) and the J/22's small control-line tails (cunningham, jib car adjusters) where a cam cleat is too big
card.distance: arm's reach in the cockpit; the camera passes close when the player trims a control line
card.before: none: the kit had no V-cleat; control lines used CamCleat

references.use: three-quarter view from above: the moulding's shape, tail pocket, fairlead eye, raked ridges in the V, nose (crop of Bean's hardware reference sheet, Nov 8 2026; a retailer photo: for looking at only, never shipped)

references.note: Small V-cleat with fairlead, 3-6 mm line: 4 mm fasteners on 48 mm hole centres, 11 g (Premium Ropes, Eastmarine Asia listings); the open version without the eye is 36 mm centres, 9 g. No retailer lists the overall length or height: 70 x 18 x 21.5 mm is read off the photo against the 48 mm centres

sizes.name: Overall length
sizes.source: photo estimate against the 48 mm centres (no catalogue figure)

features.text: One dark composite moulding, low at the tail and rising in a smooth line to a rounded nose, rounded in plan at both ends
V jaw open on top, narrowing to the bottom, closed by the nose wall
Raked ridges on both V walls, leaning toward the tail
Oval fairlead eye through the bulkhead between the pocket and the jaw, with a solid bridge over it
Tail pocket inside a rim, with the aft screw countersunk in its floor
Forward screw down at the bottom of the V
A 6 mm line sits in the V below the top edges and runs out through the eye
Maker's mark on the outboard cheek (made-up TERNWAY plate, no real logo)
Flat underside, sits on the deck with no gap

budget.note: hero is a Nanite part; build_kit makes the light copy at a quarter of the triangles
